blocks.zh: 供應鏈、老化設施與法規變更申請
blocks.en: Supply Chain, Aging Facilities and Post-Approval Changes

blocks.zh: 本節涵蓋內容 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解風險控制領域（表 6.1.4）中「材料與供應商管理」、「業務持續運作」與「法規考量」三大類別的核心要素，並能應用於 CDMO 合約製造場景。
blocks.en: Understand the core elements of the three risk control categories in Table 6.1.4 (Materials and Supplier Management, Business Continuity, and Regulatory Considerations), and be able to apply them in CDMO contract manufacturing scenarios.

blocks.zh: 掌握價值流圖（Value Stream Mapping, VSM）的組成要素與應用步驟，能識別無菌製造流程中的庫存瓶頸與供應壓力點。
blocks.en: Master the components and application steps of Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and be able to identify inventory bottlenecks and supply stress points in sterile manufacturing processes.

blocks.zh: 分析老化設施與技術對藥品短缺的根本原因與影響後果，了解「延遲維護陷阱」（deferred maintenance trap）的財務與法規風險。
blocks.en: Analyze the root causes and consequences of aging facilities and technology for drug shortages, and understand the financial and regulatory risks of the "deferred maintenance trap".

blocks.zh: 了解分析控制系統的生命週期管理策略，掌握 PAC 申請時程（2–5 年）對 CDMO 技術升級計畫的影響，並制定前瞻性更新週期。
blocks.en: Understand lifecycle management strategies for analytical control systems, grasp how the PAC (post-approval change) timeline (2-5 years) affects CDMO technology upgrade plans, and set forward-looking renewal cycles.

blocks.zh: 說明 ICH Q12 框架下「法規彈性」與全球變更協議（global Change Protocol, gCP）的概念，理解其對 CDMO 客戶多地點製造核准的實際效益。
blocks.en: Explain the concepts of "regulatory flexibility" and the global Change Protocol (gCP) under the ICH Q12 framework, and understand their practical benefits for CDMO clients seeking approval of multiple manufacturing sites.

blocks.zh: Table 6.1.4🔍 Risk Control Areas (Continuation) — 風險控制領域（續）
blocks.en: Table 6.1.4🔍 Risk Control Areas (Continuation)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：風險控制三大支柱
blocks.en: Commentary: The Three Pillars of Risk Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三大風險控制領域
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Risk Control Areas

blocks.zh: 表 6.1.4 的後三個類別形成藥品供應保障的「三角支柱」：
blocks.en: The last three categories in Table 6.1.4 form the "three pillars" of drug supply assurance:

blocks.zh: 材料與供應商管理：確保原料與組件的穩定獲取，核心在於備用供應商與安全庫存設計。
blocks.en: Materials and Supplier Management: ensure stable access to raw materials and components; the core is backup suppliers and safety stock design.

blocks.zh: 業務持續運作：針對不可預期衝擊（天災、疫情、地緣政治）建立回復計畫。
blocks.en: Business Continuity: build recovery plans for unpredictable shocks (natural disasters, pandemics, geopolitics).

blocks.zh: 法規考量：掌握多國法規變動，管理法規核准時間差對供應的影響。
blocks.en: Regulatory Considerations: keep track of regulatory changes across countries, and manage the impact of differences in regulatory approval timing on supply.

blocks.zh: 比喻：供應鏈如同三腳凳
blocks.en: Analogy: The Supply Chain Is Like a Three-Legged Stool

blocks.zh: 供應鏈風險控制好比一張三腳凳——材料管理、業務持續、法規配合缺一不可。即使製造技術再先進，若 API 唯一供應商突然中斷、或多個國家尚未核准新製造廠，藥品仍會短缺。CDMO 的合約中需明確這三個面向的責任分工。
blocks.en: Supply chain risk control is like a three-legged stool: materials management, business continuity and regulatory alignment are all indispensable. However advanced the manufacturing technology, if the sole API supplier suddenly stops, or several countries have not yet approved a new manufacturing site, the drug will still be short. A CDMO contract should define the division of responsibility for all three aspects.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的「雙重角色」
blocks.en: Key Point: The CDMO's "Dual Role"

blocks.zh: CDMO 在此框架中同時扮演兩個角色：作為 MAH 的「關鍵供應商」，需提供充足的供應商管理資訊；作為「獨立製造商」，自身也必須維持業務持續運作計畫（BCP）並主動管理法規核准狀態。建議在品質協議（Quality Agreement）中明確約定雙方的 BCP 演練頻率與資訊共享義務。
blocks.en: In this framework a CDMO plays two roles at once: as a "critical supplier" to the MAH, it must provide sufficient supplier management information; as an "independent manufacturer", it must also maintain its own business continuity plan (BCP) and proactively manage regulatory approval status. It is advisable to agree explicitly in the Quality Agreement on the frequency of BCP exercises and on information-sharing obligations for both parties.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：安全庫存計算
blocks.en: Practical Application: Safety Stock Calculation

blocks.zh: 「安全庫存管理」不只是持有額外庫存，而是基於：
blocks.en: "Safety stock management" is not just holding extra inventory; it is based on:

blocks.zh: 前置時間（lead time）變異性
blocks.en: Variability of lead time

blocks.zh: 需求波動（季節性、疫情突增）
blocks.en: Demand fluctuation (seasonality, pandemic surges)

blocks.zh: 供應商中斷概率評估
blocks.en: Assessment of the probability of supplier disruption

blocks.zh: 結合 VSM 的庫存可視化，才能做到「不過度積壓、又不斷鏈」的精準管理。
blocks.en: Only by combining this with the inventory visibility from VSM can you achieve precise management that is "neither overstocked nor out of stock".

blocks.zh: 6.2 Supply Chain and Value Stream Mapping — 供應鏈與價值流圖
blocks.en: 6.2 Supply Chain and Value Stream Mapping

blocks.zh: 中文解析：VSM 的核心價值
blocks.en: Commentary: The Core Value of VSM

blocks.zh: 核心概念：MAH 的端對端責任
blocks.en: Core Concept: The MAH's End-to-End Responsibility

blocks.zh: 藥品上市許可持有人（MAH）對整個供應鏈負有最終責任，不能因委託給 CDMO 就免除風險管理義務。MAH 不僅要評估自身風險，還必須審核 CDMO、CLO 等關鍵服務商的 QRM（品質風險管理）框架是否符合 ICH Q9(R1) 原則。
blocks.en: The Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) bears ultimate responsibility for the entire supply chain, and cannot be relieved of risk management obligations by outsourcing to a CDMO. The MAH must not only assess its own risks but also review whether the QRM (quality risk management) frameworks of key service providers such as the CDMO and CLO comply with ICH Q9(R1) principles.

blocks.zh: 比喻：VSM 就像製造現場的「生產看板」
blocks.en: Analogy: VSM Is Like a Production Board on the Shop Floor

blocks.zh: 想像您走進一間工廠，牆上掛著一張大型流程圖，顯示每個工序站、物料在各站停留的時間，以及瓶頸位置——這就是 VSM 的精髓。VSM 源自豐田生產系統（TPS）的「物料與資訊流圖」，製藥業將其應用於識別：
blocks.en: Imagine walking into a factory with a large flow chart on the wall showing each process station, how long material stays at each station, and where the bottlenecks are. That is the essence of VSM. VSM derives from the "material and information flow map" of the Toyota Production System (TPS), and the pharmaceutical industry applies it to identify:

blocks.zh: 哪個環節庫存積壓最多？（隱藏的資金與風險）
blocks.en: Where does inventory pile up most? (hidden capital and risk)

blocks.zh: 哪個工序是真正的瓶頸？（生產速度的天花板）
blocks.en: Which process step is the real bottleneck? (the ceiling on production speed)

blocks.zh: 資訊流（訂單、排程）是否與物料流同步？
blocks.en: Is the information flow (orders, schedules) synchronized with the material flow?

blocks.zh: VSM 讓供應鏈從「黑盒子」變成「透明玻璃箱」，是藥品短缺的預防性與反應性雙重工具。
blocks.en: VSM turns the supply chain from a "black box" into a "transparent glass box", and is both a preventive and a reactive tool for drug shortages.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：五大要素缺一不可
blocks.en: Key Point: All Five Elements Are Essential

blocks.zh: 有效 VSM 的五大要素（Team → Planning → Evaluation → Map → Action List）必須按序完成。常見錯誤：跳過「評估」步驟，直接畫圖；或畫完圖後沒有建立「行動清單」。沒有行動清單的 VSM 只是好看的裝飾品，無法真正降低短缺風險。
blocks.en: The five elements of an effective VSM (Team → Planning → Evaluation → Map → Action List) must be completed in sequence. Common mistakes: skipping the "Evaluation" step and drawing the map directly, or finishing the map without creating an "Action List". A VSM without an action list is just a nice decoration and cannot truly reduce shortage risk.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：其他映射工具的選擇
blocks.en: Practical Application: Choosing Other Mapping Tools

blocks.zh: 當 VSM 範圍過大或複雜度超出單一流程時，可考慮替代工具：
blocks.en: When the VSM scope is too large or its complexity exceeds a single process, consider alternative tools:

blocks.zh: DRIVE：適合需要系統性問題解決的情境
blocks.en: DRIVE: suited to situations that need systematic problem solving

blocks.zh: ICOR：強調輸入/輸出/控制/資源的四維分析
blocks.en: ICOR: emphasizes a four-dimensional analysis of inputs/outputs/controls/resources

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖：適合根本原因分析，識別短缺的多層原因
blocks.en: Fishbone diagram: suited to root cause analysis, identifying the multiple layers of causes of a shortage

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 實務中，建議結合 VSM + 魚骨圖，先用 VSM 找出瓶頸，再用魚骨圖深挖根因。
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, combine VSM with a fishbone diagram: use VSM first to find the bottleneck, then use the fishbone to dig into the root cause.

blocks.zh: Information Flow (上方):
blocks.en: Information Flow (top):

blocks.zh: Material Flow & Inventory (下方製造流程):
blocks.en: Material Flow & Inventory (manufacturing process, bottom):

blocks.zh: 中文解析：圖 6.2-1 深度解讀
blocks.en: Commentary: In-Depth Reading of Figure 6.2-1

blocks.zh: 比喻：每個「庫存小時數」代表什麼？
blocks.en: Analogy: What Does Each "Inventory Hours" Figure Represent?

blocks.zh: VSM 中的「庫存（hrs）」數字代表物料在兩個工序之間等待的平均時數。這些不是「生產時間」，而是「停滯時間」。以下是關鍵數字的實務意涵：
blocks.en: The "inventory (hrs)" figures in a VSM are the average hours that material waits between two process steps. These are not "production time" but "idle time". The practical meaning of the key figures is as follows:

blocks.zh:
Receiving: 120 hrs = 5 個工作天
到料後需等 5 天才進入進廠檢驗。這是原物料緩衝庫存，確保即使供應商延遲交貨仍有備料。但過高也代表積壓資金與潛在品質風險（尤其對溫度敏感原料）。
blocks.en:
Receiving: 120 hrs = 5 working days
After arrival, material waits 5 days before incoming inspection. This is a raw material buffer stock, ensuring that material is still on hand even if a supplier delivers late. But too high a figure also means tied-up capital and potential quality risk (especially for temperature-sensitive materials).

blocks.zh:
Incoming Inspection: 33 hrs ≈ 1.4 天
進廠檢驗等待時間，反映 QC 實驗室的排程與檢驗週期。可透過快速微生物檢驗（RMM）或預認證原料（pre-approved）縮短。
blocks.en:
Incoming Inspection: 33 hrs ≈ 1.4 days
The waiting time for incoming inspection, reflecting QC laboratory scheduling and testing cycle. It can be shortened with rapid microbiological methods (RMM) or pre-approved materials.

blocks.zh:
Inventory: 0.5 hrs
幾乎即時流入下一工序，代表此緩衝幾乎不存在——高效率，但也缺乏彈性。
blocks.en:
Inventory: 0.5 hrs
Material flows almost immediately to the next step, meaning this buffer is practically absent: highly efficient, but also lacking flexibility.

blocks.zh:
QC & Final Release: 95 hrs = 約 4 天
這是整個流程最大的瓶頸！成品等待 QC 放行的時間佔總等待時間的 26%。這是最值得投資改善的環節。
blocks.en:
QC & Final Release: 95 hrs = about 4 days
This is the biggest bottleneck in the whole process! The time finished product waits for QC release accounts for 26% of total waiting time. This is the step most worth investing in for improvement.

blocks.zh:
Warehousing/Ship: 28.8 hrs ≈ 1.2 天
出貨前的倉儲等待，與全球配送排程有關。
blocks.en:
Warehousing/Ship: 28.8 hrs ≈ 1.2 days
Warehouse waiting before shipment, related to global distribution schedules.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：QC 瓶頸是藥品短缺的隱形殺手
blocks.en: Key Point: The QC Bottleneck Is the Silent Killer of Drug Supply

blocks.zh: 在這張 VSM 中，QC & Final Release 的 95 hrs 是最大的庫存堆積點。這意味著：
blocks.en: In this VSM, the 95 hrs at QC & Final Release is the largest inventory accumulation point. This means:

blocks.zh: 若 QC 發生 OOS（超規格結果）調查，這 95 hrs 可能膨脹至 500+ hrs
blocks.en: If QC has an OOS (out-of-specification result) investigation, these 95 hrs can balloon to 500+ hrs

blocks.zh: 每批次進入 QC Hold 都可能延誤出貨，累積成短缺
blocks.en: Every batch that goes on QC Hold may delay shipment and accumulate into a shortage

blocks.zh: CDMO 應優先投資：更快的無菌檢驗替代方法（如快速 SAL 方法）、更充足的 QC 人力排程、以及提前啟動的穩定性計畫
blocks.en: A CDMO should prioritize investment in: faster alternative sterility test methods (such as rapid SAL methods), more adequate QC staffing schedules, and stability programs started earlier

blocks.zh: 核心概念：VSM 的雙重用途
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Dual Purpose of VSM

blocks.zh: 製藥 VSM 與傳統精實製造 VSM 最大的差異在於目的：
blocks.en: The biggest difference between a pharmaceutical VSM and a traditional Lean Manufacturing VSM is the purpose:

blocks.zh: 傳統 VSM：最小化庫存 → 降低成本
blocks.en: Traditional VSM: minimize inventory → reduce cost

blocks.zh: 製藥 VSM：維持適當庫存 → 確保不斷貨
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical VSM: maintain appropriate inventory → ensure no stock-outs

blocks.zh: 以 Receiving 的 120 hrs 為例——在傳統精實觀點下這是「浪費」，但在製藥供應韌性觀點下，這是因應 API 供應商（印度/中國）3-4 週前置時間的必要安全緩衝。合理性取決於風險評估，而非純粹效率追求。
blocks.en: Take the 120 hrs at Receiving: from a traditional Lean viewpoint this is "waste", but from a pharmaceutical supply resilience viewpoint, it is a necessary safety buffer against the 3-4 week lead time of API suppliers (India/China). Whether it is reasonable depends on risk assessment, not on the pursuit of pure efficiency.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1：找出您廠的瓶頸
blocks.en: Exercise 1: Find the Bottleneck at Your Site

blocks.zh: 如果您要為自己廠的一個代表產品繪製 VSM，請回答：
blocks.en: If you were to draw a VSM for a representative product at your own site, answer the following:

blocks.zh: 您的 QC Final Release 平均等待幾小時？（與圖中 95 hrs 相比如何？）
blocks.en: How many hours does your QC Final Release wait on average? (How does it compare with the 95 hrs in the figure?)

blocks.zh: 哪個工序的庫存等待時間最長？原因是什麼？
blocks.en: Which process step has the longest inventory waiting time? What is the reason?

blocks.zh: 若這個瓶頸工序突然額外延遲 48 小時，最快何時會影響出貨？
blocks.en: If this bottleneck step were suddenly delayed by an extra 48 hours, how soon would it affect shipments?

blocks.zh: 提示：這個練習也是藥品短缺防範計畫（Drug Shortage Prevention Plan）的起點。
blocks.en: Hint: this exercise is also the starting point of a Drug Shortage Prevention Plan.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：老化設施的根因與後果
blocks.en: Commentary: Root Causes and Consequences of Aging Facilities

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「老化」的定義不只是年齡
blocks.en: Core Concept: "Aging" Is Not Just About Age

blocks.zh: 設施、製程、分析技術的「老化」不等於使用年限長。TR68 定義的老化是指：不再符合現行標準或監管期望的狀態。一個建造於 2005 年、但從未更新的設施，可能在 GMP 符合性、製程能力、或設備支援上已「老化」。老化的真正觸發因素往往是管理決策，而非時間本身。
blocks.en: The "aging" of facilities, processes and analytical technologies does not equal a long service life. TR68 defines aging as a state of no longer meeting current standards or regulatory expectations. A facility built in 2005 and never updated may already be "aged" in GMP compliance, process capability or equipment support. The real trigger of aging is often a management decision, not time itself.

blocks.zh: 比喻：延遲維護陷阱（Deferred Maintenance Trap）
blocks.en: Analogy: The Deferred Maintenance Trap

blocks.zh: 想像一部汽車的車主決定「省錢」，跳過定期保養。最初幾個月看起來沒問題，但發動機磨損在悄悄累積。等到引擎徹底故障，修理費用是正常保養費的十倍，而且車子還停駛了兩週。
blocks.en: Imagine a car owner who decides to "save money" by skipping regular servicing. For the first few months everything looks fine, but engine wear quietly accumulates. By the time the engine fails completely, the repair costs ten times the normal servicing, and the car is also off the road for two weeks.

blocks.zh: 製藥設施完全相同：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical facilities are exactly the same:

blocks.zh: 短期「節省」：減少維護預算、延後設備升級
blocks.en: Short-term "savings": reducing the maintenance budget, delaying equipment upgrades

blocks.zh: 長期「代價」：設備故障停產、FDA Warning Letter、產品召回、甚至工廠關閉
blocks.en: Long-term "cost": equipment failure and production stoppage, FDA Warning Letters, product recalls, even plant closure

blocks.zh: FDA 483 和 Warning Letter 中，大量案例源自「Inadequate maintenance program」或「Equipment not maintained in a state of control」——這正是延遲維護陷阱的法規後果。
blocks.en: Many cases in FDA 483s and Warning Letters stem from "Inadequate maintenance program" or "Equipment not maintained in a state of control", which is precisely the regulatory consequence of the deferred maintenance trap.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「關鍵人員依賴」是隱性老化風險
blocks.en: Key Point: "Key Person Dependency" Is a Hidden Aging Risk

blocks.zh: TR68 特別指出一個常被忽略的老化風險：設施/製程的運作高度依賴少數資深員工的個人知識。這些人知道設備的「脾氣」、非正式的操作技巧，但這些知識從未被系統化記錄。當他們退休或離職，繼任者依照 SOP 操作卻頻繁出現偏差——這不是新問題，而是老化系統的第一次「誠實呈現」。
blocks.en: TR68 points out an aging risk that is often overlooked: the operation of a facility/process depends heavily on the personal knowledge of a few senior employees. These people know the equipment's "temperament" and informal operating tricks, but this knowledge has never been systematically documented. When they retire or leave, their successors follow the SOPs yet deviations occur frequently. This is not a new problem; it is the first time the aging system is "honestly presented".

blocks.zh: 對策：定期進行「知識風險評估」，識別高度個人依賴的製程，強制進行知識轉移與 SOP 更新。
blocks.en: Countermeasure: conduct periodic "knowledge risk assessments" to identify processes with high personal dependency, and require knowledge transfer and SOP updates.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：老化設施風險評分矩陣
blocks.en: Practical Application: Aging Facility Risk Scoring Matrix

blocks.zh: 建議建立設施設備老化風險評估，涵蓋：
blocks.en: It is advisable to establish an aging risk assessment for facilities and equipment, covering:

blocks.zh: 設備製造商支援狀態（是否已停產、備件可取得性）
blocks.en: Equipment manufacturer support status (whether discontinued, availability of spare parts)

blocks.zh: 與現行 GMP 法規的符合性差距
blocks.en: Compliance gaps against current GMP regulations

blocks.zh: 過去 3 年的維護事件頻率趨勢
blocks.en: Trend in maintenance event frequency over the past 3 years

blocks.zh: 設計是否容易出現人為錯誤（human error vulnerability）
blocks.en: Whether the design is prone to human error (human error vulnerability)

blocks.zh: 製程能力指數（Cpk）趨勢——是否在下降？
blocks.en: Trend of the process capability index (Cpk): is it declining?

blocks.zh: 結果應納入廠區風險登記冊（Site Risk Register），並與資本支出計畫（CapEx Plan）直接掛鉤。
blocks.en: The results should be entered in the Site Risk Register and linked directly to the Capital Expenditure Plan (CapEx Plan).

blocks.zh: 中文解析：持續改善的商業案例
blocks.en: Commentary: The Business Case for Continual Improvement

blocks.zh: 核心概念：持續改善 = ICH Q10 的核心要求
blocks.en: Core Concept: Continual Improvement = a Core Requirement of ICH Q10

blocks.zh: ICH Q10「製藥品質系統」將持續改善（Continual Improvement）列為製藥品質系統的四大核心要素之一（與知識管理、PQS、CAPA 並列）。這不是「加分項目」，而是監管期望的基本要求。TR68 進一步強調：持續改善是預防設施老化導致藥品短缺的主動防線。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 "Pharmaceutical Quality System" lists Continual Improvement as one of the four core elements of the pharmaceutical quality system (alongside knowledge management, PQS and CAPA). This is not a "bonus item" but a basic regulatory expectation. TR68 further stresses that continual improvement is a proactive line of defense against drug shortages caused by facility aging.

blocks.zh: 比喻：單次使用技術的「換湯不換藥」革命
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Same Soup, New Bowl" Revolution of Single-Use Technology

blocks.zh: 傳統不鏽鋼設備就像一個需要每次清洗消毒的大型廚房器具——費時費力，且每次清洗都有交叉污染風險。
blocks.en: Traditional stainless steel equipment is like a large kitchen appliance that has to be cleaned and sanitized every time: time-consuming and laborious, with a cross-contamination risk at each cleaning.

blocks.zh: 單次使用技術（SUS）就像用拋棄式容器：用完即丟，下次立即換新，省去清潔驗證、縮短周轉時間，還降低了批次間交叉污染風險。這不只是成本考量，更是供應可靠性的提升——更快的批次周轉 = 更多的年度批次產量。
blocks.en: Single-use technology (SUS) is like using disposable containers: throw them away after use and replace them immediately next time, which removes cleaning validation, shortens turnaround time and lowers the risk of batch-to-batch cross-contamination. This is not just a cost consideration but an improvement in supply reliability: faster batch turnaround = more batches per year.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：漸進式改善 vs. 破壞性創新
blocks.en: Key Point: Gradual Improvement vs. Disruptive Innovation

blocks.zh: TR68 特別強調「漸進式持續改善」（gradual improvements）與「破壞性技術創新」同樣重要：
blocks.en: TR68 specifically stresses that "gradual improvements" in continual improvement are just as important as "disruptive technological innovation":

blocks.zh: 更新老舊 HMI 介面到更直觀的觸控系統
blocks.en: Upgrade old HMI interfaces to more intuitive touchscreen systems

blocks.zh: 將手動記錄替換為電子批次記錄（eBR）
blocks.en: Replace manual records with electronic batch records (eBR)

blocks.zh: 導入 PAT（製程分析技術）的即時監測功能
blocks.en: Introduce the real-time monitoring functions of PAT (process analytical technology)

blocks.zh: 這些「小步驟」積累的文化，才是真正避免設施老化的長期保障。表現出正確的品質態度與所有權意識，正是監管機構在 GMP 檢查中最想看到的。
blocks.en: A culture built from these "small steps" is the real long-term safeguard against facility aging. Showing the right quality attitude and sense of ownership is exactly what regulators most want to see in GMP inspections.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：建立技術更新路線圖
blocks.en: Practical Application: Build a Technology Roadmap

blocks.zh: 建議每個 CDMO 廠區建立 3-5 年「技術更新路線圖（Technology Roadmap）」：
blocks.en: Each CDMO site should build a 3-5 year "Technology Roadmap":

blocks.zh: 盤點所有關鍵設備的製造商支援結束日期（End-of-Life）
blocks.en: Inventory all critical equipment and the manufacturer support end dates (End-of-Life)

blocks.zh: 評估下一代設備的技術優勢與 PAC 申請需求
blocks.en: Evaluate the technical advantages of next-generation equipment and the PAC filing requirements

blocks.zh: 將 PAC 申請時程（2-5 年）納入更新計畫的前置作業
blocks.en: Include the PAC timeline (2-5 years) in the lead-up work of the renewal plan

blocks.zh: 與客戶 MAH 協調設備變更的法規申報策略
blocks.en: Coordinate the regulatory filing strategy for equipment changes with the client MAH

blocks.zh: 此路線圖應每年更新，並納入廠區管理審查（Management Review）的討論議程。
blocks.en: This roadmap should be updated every year and included on the agenda of the site Management Review.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：分析技術生命週期管理
blocks.en: Commentary: Lifecycle Management of Analytical Technology

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「技術時差」問題
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "Technology Lag" Problem

blocks.zh: TR68 揭示了一個結構性矛盾：分析技術本身在快速進步（每 3-5 年就有新一代技術），但藥品的分析控制系統（放行方法、穩定性方法、規格標準）幾乎一成不變。原因在於每次更新都需要提交 PAC，而 PAC 核准需要 2-5 年。
blocks.en: TR68 reveals a structural contradiction: analytical technology itself advances quickly (a new generation every 3-5 years), but the analytical control system of a drug (release methods, stability methods, specifications) stays almost unchanged. The reason is that each update requires a PAC submission, and PAC approval takes 2-5 years.

blocks.zh: 這個「技術時差」（Technology Lag）導致：市面上已有更準確、更快速的分析方法，但廠房仍在使用二十年前的舊方法——不是不想改，是改不起或改不完。
blocks.en: This "Technology Lag" means that more accurate and faster analytical methods are already available, but sites are still using methods from twenty years ago; it is not that they do not want to change, but that they cannot afford to or cannot finish changing.

blocks.zh: 比喻：PAC 時程就像翻修老宅的「施工許可證」
blocks.en: Analogy: The PAC Timeline Is Like a Building Permit for Renovating an Old House

blocks.zh: 想翻修一棟老房子（更新分析方法）：您有新設計圖（新技術），但要動工前必須向每個縣市申請施工許可（各國 PAC）。如果您的房子在 5 個國家都有，光跑完所有許可就要 3-5 年——而在等待過程中，房子的問題繼續存在。
blocks.en: You want to renovate an old house (update an analytical method): you have the new design (new technology), but before starting work you must apply for a building permit from every county and city (PACs in each country). If your house exists in 5 countries, just completing all the permits takes 3-5 years, and while you wait, the problems in the house continue.

blocks.zh: 這就是為何 TR68 強調要「主動提前規劃」分析控制系統的更新：在當前方法還沒出問題前，就要啟動 PAC 流程。等到出了 OOS 或失效率升高再申請，已經是亡羊補牢，藥品短缺難以避免。
blocks.en: This is why TR68 stresses proactive advance planning for updating the analytical control system: start the PAC process before the current method has a problem. Applying only after an OOS or a rise in failure rate is locking the barn door after the horse has bolted, and a drug shortage is hard to avoid.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：每五年定期評估是監管期望
blocks.en: Key Point: A Periodic Five-Year Review Is a Regulatory Expectation

blocks.zh: TR68 明確建議分析控制系統應「每五年定期審查」（every five years）。這不只是最佳實踐，而是符合 ICH Q10 持續改善精神的監管期望。CDMO 應建立正式的「分析方法生命週期審查程序（Analytical Method Lifecycle Review SOP）」，包含：
blocks.en: TR68 clearly recommends that analytical control systems be "reviewed periodically, every five years". This is not just good practice but a regulatory expectation in keeping with the ICH Q10 spirit of continual improvement. A CDMO should establish a formal "Analytical Method Lifecycle Review SOP", including:

blocks.zh: 定期（至少每 5 年）的控制系統整體評估觸發點
blocks.en: A trigger point for periodic (at least every 5 years) overall evaluation of the control system

blocks.zh: 觸發即時審查的事件清單（高失敗率、新 CQA 識別、監管要求更新）
blocks.en: A list of events that trigger an immediate review (high failure rate, newly identified CQAs, updated regulatory requirements)

blocks.zh: 評估結果與 PAC 計畫的連結機制
blocks.en: A mechanism linking the evaluation results to the PAC plan

blocks.zh: 製程能力指數（Cpk）與規格標準的一致性驗證
blocks.en: Verification that the process capability index (Cpk) is consistent with the specifications

blocks.zh: 實務應用：容忍區間與規格評估
blocks.en: Practical Application: Tolerance Intervals and Specification Evaluation

blocks.zh: TR68 提供了一個具體的統計工具：使用歷史批次的 95% 或 99% 容忍區間與現有規格標準比較。
blocks.en: TR68 offers a concrete statistical tool: compare the 95% or 99% tolerance interval of historical batches with the current specifications.

blocks.zh: 若容忍區間與規格上/下限的距離太小（Cpk 偏低）→ 規格可能需要收緊或製程需要改善
blocks.en: If the tolerance interval is too close to the upper/lower specification limit (low Cpk) → the specification may need tightening or the process needs improvement

blocks.zh: 若實際製程能力遠優於規格（Cpk >> 1.33）→ 可能有機會放寬放行規格以降低 OOS 風險
blocks.en: If actual process capability is far better than the specification (Cpk >> 1.33) → there may be an opportunity to widen the release specification to reduce OOS risk

blocks.zh: 參考：PDA TR59 (Revised 2012) — Utilization of Statistical Methods for Production Monitoring，提供詳細的 Cpk 計算與應用指引。
blocks.en: Reference: PDA TR59 (Revised 2012), Utilization of Statistical Methods for Production Monitoring, gives detailed guidance on Cpk calculation and application.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2：CDMO 的分析方法更新策略
blocks.en: Exercise 2: Analytical Method Update Strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 假設您的 CDMO 正在準備承接一個新的生物製劑代工案，客戶的分析方法是 2010 年開發的 HPLC 方法。請思考：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO is preparing to take on a new biologic contract manufacturing project, and the client's analytical method is an HPLC method developed in 2010. Consider:

blocks.zh: 這個方法是否符合現行 ICH Q2(R2) 的驗證要求？
blocks.en: Does this method meet the current ICH Q2(R2) validation requirements?

blocks.zh: 如果需要在方法轉移後進行更新，PAC 申請時程如何與商業供貨時程整合？
blocks.en: If an update is needed after method transfer, how should the PAC timeline be integrated with the commercial supply timeline?

blocks.zh: 客戶 MAH 是否已啟動分析控制系統的定期審查？CDMO 應如何在合約中約定這個責任？
blocks.en: Has the client MAH started a periodic review of the analytical control system? How should the CDMO assign this responsibility in the contract?

blocks.zh: 如果發現舊方法的失效率偏高（> 2%），建議的行動優先順序是什麼？
blocks.en: If the old method is found to have a high failure rate (> 2%), what is the recommended order of priority for actions?

blocks.zh: 提示：CDMO 的品質協議應明確約定分析方法生命週期管理的責任歸屬。
blocks.en: Hint: the CDMO's Quality Agreement should clearly assign responsibility for analytical method lifecycle management.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：PAC 加速審查與法規彈性
blocks.en: Commentary: Accelerated PAC Review and Regulatory Flexibility

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ICH Q12「法規彈性」
blocks.en: Core Concept: ICH Q12 "Regulatory Flexibility"

blocks.zh: 法規彈性（Regulatory Flexibility）是 ICH Q10 提出的一個激勵機制：企業若能證明其 PQS（製藥品質系統）完善、具備充分的製程與產品理解、並有效運用 QRM 原則，監管機構可允許該公司以「事後通報」代替「事前核准」管理部分 PAC——大幅縮短變更實施週期。
blocks.en: Regulatory Flexibility is an incentive mechanism put forward in ICH Q10: if a company can demonstrate a sound PQS (pharmaceutical quality system), adequate process and product understanding, and effective use of QRM principles, regulators may allow it to manage some PACs by "post-implementation notification" instead of "prior approval", greatly shortening the change implementation cycle.

blocks.zh: 簡而言之：品質文化越好的公司，法規監管越寬鬆。這是監管機構給予「信任」企業的具體回報。
blocks.en: In short: the better a company's quality culture, the lighter the regulatory oversight. This is the concrete return regulators give to companies they "trust".

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ICH Q12 的核心工具
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Core Tools of ICH Q12

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 引入了兩個關鍵概念：
blocks.en: ICH Q12 introduces two key concepts:

blocks.zh: PLCM（Product Lifecycle Management Document）：在申請時預先界定哪些未來變更可以更低的報告層級管理，讓監管機構與企業都能預期。
blocks.en: PLCM (Product Lifecycle Management Document): define at the time of filing which future changes can be managed at a lower reporting level, so that both regulators and the company know what to expect.

blocks.zh: EFPIA/PAC 分類：將 PAC 依科學風險分層，高風險仍需事前核准，低風險可事後通報或僅在 PQS 內管理。
blocks.en: EFPIA/PAC classification: stratify PACs by scientific risk; high-risk changes still need prior approval, while low-risk ones can be notified afterwards or managed only within the PQS.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，理解 ICH Q12 框架能幫助在合約談判時更準確地評估法規時程風險。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, understanding the ICH Q12 framework helps assess regulatory timeline risk more accurately during contract negotiations.

blocks.zh: 比喻：法規彈性就像「優良駕駛折扣」
blocks.en: Analogy: Regulatory Flexibility Is Like a "Good Driver Discount"

blocks.zh: 保險公司給長期無肇事紀錄的駕駛更低的保費——因為信任他們的安全記錄。ICH Q12 的法規彈性邏輯相同：有強健 PQS 的企業，監管機構「信任」其內部品質管理能力，因此給予更寬鬆的報告類別。
blocks.en: Insurance companies give drivers with a long accident-free record lower premiums, because they trust their safety record. The logic of ICH Q12 regulatory flexibility is the same: for a company with a robust PQS, regulators "trust" its internal quality management capability and therefore grant looser reporting categories.

blocks.zh: 相反地，歷史上有 Warning Letter、重大偏差，或 PQS 薄弱的企業，即使是微小的製程變更，監管機構也可能要求先審核才能實施。
blocks.en: Conversely, for companies with a history of Warning Letters, major deviations or a weak PQS, regulators may require review before implementation even of minor process changes.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：多國並行 PAC 的現實挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: The Real-World Challenge of Parallel Multi-Country PACs

blocks.zh: TR68 點出一個實務困境：各國 PAC 分類名稱不同（美國：Major/Moderate/Minor；歐盟：Type IA/IB/II；日本：Major/Minor），核准時程各異，導致同一個製程變更在不同國家的核准狀態不同步。
blocks.en: TR68 points out a practical dilemma: PAC classification names differ by country (US: Major/Moderate/Minor; EU: Type IA/IB/II; Japan: Major/Minor) and approval timelines vary, so the approval status of the same process change is out of sync across countries.

blocks.zh: 結果是：公司被迫同時維持多個版本的製造流程——一個版本給已核准的國家，另一個給尚未核准的國家。這不只是邏輯複雜，更是庫存管理的噩夢，直接增加藥品短缺的風險。
blocks.en: The result: the company is forced to maintain multiple versions of the manufacturing process at the same time, one for countries that have approved and another for those that have not. This is not just logistically complex but a nightmare for inventory management, and directly increases the risk of drug shortage.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：gCP 與加速審查機制
blocks.en: Commentary: gCP and Accelerated Review Mechanisms

blocks.zh: 核心概念：什麼是 gCP（全球變更協議）？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Is a gCP (global Change Protocol)?

blocks.zh: 全球變更協議（global Change Protocol, gCP）是由產業界與各國衛生主管機關共同預先制定的「標準變更模板」。對於特定類型的常見變更（例如：新增製造場址、更換設備），gCP 預先定義了：
blocks.en: A global Change Protocol (gCP) is a "standard change template" jointly drawn up in advance by industry and health authorities of various countries. For specific types of common changes (for example, adding a manufacturing site or replacing equipment), the gCP predefines:

blocks.zh: 所需的驗證活動（validation activities）
blocks.en: Required validation activities

blocks.zh: 數據要求（data requirements）
blocks.en: Data requirements

blocks.zh: 可接受標準（acceptance criteria）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 報告類別建議（reporting category）
blocks.en: Recommended reporting category

blocks.zh: 企業只需以 gCP 為起點，加入產品特有的具體資訊，即可完成 PAC 申請——大幅縮短準備時間，提高審查效率。
blocks.en: A company need only use the gCP as a starting point and add product-specific information to complete the PAC submission, greatly shortening preparation time and improving review efficiency.

blocks.zh: CDMO 客戶注意：新增製造場址 PAC 直接受益
blocks.en: Note for CDMO Clients: Adding a Manufacturing Site PAC Benefits Directly

blocks.zh: TR68 第 6.4 節特別列出「Additional manufacturing site or line already approved in at least one significant market」作為可加速審查的首要變更類型。
blocks.en: TR68 Section 6.4 specifically lists "Additional manufacturing site or line already approved in at least one significant market" as the first change type eligible for accelerated review.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 客戶（MAH）而言，這意味著：
blocks.en: For CDMO clients (MAHs), this means:

blocks.zh: 若您的藥品已在 ICH 核心市場（美國、歐盟、日本）有核准的製造場址（例如原廠），且 CDMO 新廠址的 GMP 水平相當，可申請加速 PAC 審查
blocks.en: If your drug already has an approved manufacturing site in a core ICH market (US, EU, Japan), for example the original site, and the new CDMO site has an equivalent GMP level, you can apply for accelerated PAC review

blocks.zh: gCP 框架可讓新廠址核准時間從 3-5 年縮短至 1-2 年（在理想情境下）
blocks.en: The gCP framework can shorten approval time for a new site from 3-5 years to 1-2 years (in an ideal scenario)

blocks.zh: CDMO 應協助 MAH 準備標準化的場址資格文件（Site Master File），使其符合 gCP 的預設數據要求
blocks.en: The CDMO should help the MAH prepare standardized site qualification documents (Site Master File) so that they meet the default data requirements of the gCP

blocks.zh: 比喻：gCP 就像「通用插座轉接頭」
blocks.en: Analogy: gCP Is Like a "Universal Plug Adapter"

blocks.zh: 以往每個國家的 PAC 要求就像各國不同規格的插座——同樣的設備，到了不同國家就需要不同的轉接頭（不同的申請文件格式與數據要求）。
blocks.en: In the past, each country's PAC requirements were like different socket standards around the world: the same equipment needs a different adapter in each country (different filing formats and data requirements).

blocks.zh: gCP 就像設計出一個「通用轉接頭」——預先包含各國主要要求的最大公約數，企業只需在通用框架上加入少量本地化內容，就能適用於多個市場的同步申請（Simultaneous Submission）。這是邁向真正法規全球化的一步。
blocks.en: A gCP is like designing a "universal adapter": it pre-includes the greatest common denominator of the major requirements of each country, so a company need only add a small amount of localized content to the universal framework to make simultaneous submissions (Simultaneous Submission) to multiple markets. This is a step towards truly global regulation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：PQS 必須涵蓋 PAC 管理
blocks.en: Practical Application: The PQS Must Cover PAC Management

blocks.zh: TR68 明確要求：企業的 PQS 必須擴展以涵蓋 PAC 的規劃與評估，特別包括：
blocks.en: TR68 explicitly requires that a company's PQS be extended to cover PAC planning and assessment, in particular:

blocks.zh: 如何對變更進行風險評估
blocks.en: How to perform risk assessment on changes

blocks.zh: 如何展示風險控制措施
blocks.en: How to demonstrate risk control measures

blocks.zh: PAC 管理協議（PAC Management Protocol）的建立
blocks.en: Establishing a PAC Management Protocol

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著您的變更控制程序（Change Control SOP）必須有明確的 PAC 分類決策樹，並與客戶 MAH 的全球申報策略對接。PIC/S 文件《如何評估製藥品質系統在風險型變更管理中的有效性》提供了具體的評估框架，建議作為程序設計的參考。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means your Change Control SOP must contain a clear PAC classification decision tree and connect with the client MAH's global filing strategy. The PIC/S document "How to Evaluate the Effectiveness of a Pharmaceutical Quality System in Risk-Based Change Management" provides a concrete evaluation framework and is recommended as a reference for procedure design.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：監管機構鼓勵創新的激勵機制
blocks.en: Core Concept: Incentives for Regulators to Encourage Innovation

blocks.zh: TR68 提出一個前瞻性建議：衛生主管機關應對採用創新技術（以降低風險並可量測地預防短缺）的企業提供法規激勵（regulatory incentives）。被點名的創新技術包括：
blocks.en: TR68 makes a forward-looking recommendation: health authorities should provide regulatory incentives to companies that adopt innovative technologies (to reduce risk and measurably prevent shortages). The innovative technologies named include:

blocks.zh: 隔離器技術（Isolator Technology）取代傳統開放製程
blocks.en: Isolator technology replacing conventional open processes

blocks.zh: 封閉式製造系統（Closed Manufacturing Systems）
blocks.en: Closed manufacturing systems

blocks.zh: 快速微生物方法（Rapid Microbiology Methods）
blocks.en: Rapid microbiology methods

blocks.zh: 縮短製造週期時間的技術
blocks.en: Technologies that shorten manufacturing cycle time

blocks.zh: 提升製程能力（Process Capability）的技術
blocks.en: Technologies that improve process capability

blocks.zh: 這個激勵框架尚在倡議階段，但代表了監管科學的重要發展方向——值得 CDMO 在技術投資決策中納入考量。
blocks.en: This incentive framework is still at the advocacy stage, but it represents an important direction in regulatory science, and is worth taking into account in a CDMO's technology investment decisions.

blocks.zh: 本節重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 表 6.1.4 三大風險控制領域：材料與供應商管理（備用供應商、安全庫存、VSM）、業務持續運作（天災疫情地緣政治、復原計畫）、法規考量（多國法規時程差異管理）共同構成藥品供應保障的基礎架構。CDMO 在品質協議中應明確各方責任分工。
blocks.en: The three risk control areas in Table 6.1.4: Materials and Supplier Management (backup suppliers, safety stock, VSM), Business Continuity (natural disasters, pandemics, geopolitics, recovery plans) and Regulatory Considerations (managing differences in regulatory timelines across countries) together form the basic framework of drug supply assurance. In the Quality Agreement, a CDMO should clearly define the division of responsibilities among the parties.

blocks.zh: 價值流圖（VSM）是供應短缺防範的核心工具：圖 6.2-1 的無菌製造 VSM 示例顯示，QC & Final Release（95 hrs）是最大的流程瓶頸，佔總等待時間的 26%。VSM 在製藥業的目的是維持適當庫存以確保不斷貨，而非單純縮減庫存。有效 VSM 必須包含五大要素：團隊組成、計畫準備、評估、繪圖、行動清單。
blocks.en: Value Stream Mapping (VSM) is a core tool for shortage prevention: the sterile manufacturing VSM example in Figure 6.2-1 shows that QC & Final Release (95 hrs) is the largest process bottleneck, accounting for 26% of total waiting time. The purpose of VSM in the pharmaceutical industry is to maintain appropriate inventory to ensure no stock-outs, not simply to reduce inventory. An effective VSM must include five elements: team formation, planning, evaluation, mapping and action list.

blocks.zh: 老化設施是藥品短缺的系統性根因：主要原因包括短視的成本節省決策（延遲維護陷阱）、對設備淘汰缺乏長期規劃、以及「關鍵人員依賴」的隱性知識風險。ICH Q10 的持續改善要求是對抗設施老化的主動策略，單次使用技術（SUS）是重要的改善方向。
blocks.en: Aging facilities are a systemic root cause of drug shortages: the main causes include short-sighted cost-saving decisions (the deferred maintenance trap), lack of long-term planning for equipment obsolescence, and the hidden knowledge risk of "key person dependency". The continual improvement requirement of ICH Q10 is the proactive strategy against facility aging, and single-use technology (SUS) is an important direction for improvement.

blocks.zh: 分析控制系統生命週期管理需主動規劃：PAC 核准時程（2-5 年）創造了「技術時差」問題。建議每五年進行一次系統性評估，評估指標包括 Cpk 趨勢、失效率、與現行法規的符合性差距。分析方法更新應與製程改善及製造場址轉移的 PAC 申報統籌協調。
blocks.en: Lifecycle management of analytical control systems needs proactive planning: the PAC approval timeline (2-5 years) creates the "technology lag" problem. A systematic evaluation every five years is recommended, with indicators including Cpk trends, failure rates and compliance gaps against current regulations. Analytical method updates should be coordinated with process improvements and the PAC filings for manufacturing site transfers.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 的法規彈性與 gCP 是 CDMO 的重要機遇：企業若能展示強健的 PQS，可申請以更低報告類別管理 PAC，縮短法規審查時間。全球變更協議（gCP）為常見變更類型提供標準化模板，CDMO 客戶在申請新製造場址核准時可直接受益。確保有效 PQS 是獲取法規彈性的前提條件。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 regulatory flexibility and gCP are important opportunities for CDMOs: a company that can demonstrate a robust PQS can apply to manage PACs at a lower reporting category, shortening regulatory review time. The global Change Protocol (gCP) provides standardized templates for common change types, and CDMO clients benefit directly when applying for approval of a new manufacturing site. Ensuring an effective PQS is the prerequisite for obtaining regulatory flexibility.
